notes.title: VERSION 1.01b (HOTFIX)
notes.content:
What's up? Anything? No? Still holed up in your apartments and houses fearing the outside world? Us too. Hang in there.

Super minor update - our previous version of the STREAMER'S DELIGHT update accidentally bugged the messaging on the title screen, telling players that they needed to hit a whopping 200,000 points in Classic Mode in order to unlock the next mode, instead of displaying the actual score threshold of 50,000.

The main thing to note is that[b] this was just a string error, not a code one[/b] - that is, even though it was displaying 200k, the actual number you needed to hit has always been 50k.

This only really affected newer players that haven't unlocked any mode other than CLASSIC. If you have all the game modes unlocked this is just another maddening day for you.

We love you all. Wash your hands and stay safe.

[i][b]-ATKMTN[/b][/i]

tags.bug: this was just a string error, not a code one

notes.title: VERSION 1.1, 'STREAMER'S DELIGHT', RELEASED
notes.content:
[b]QUACK ATTACK 1985 : TURBO DX EDITION
VERSION 1.1 - "STREAMER'S DELIGHT"[/b]

Today's version update contains some requested quality of life improvements for [b]QUACK ATTACK 1985: TURBO DX EDITION[/b]. Not that Duckster cares - he's got nothing left to live for. Being able to stream his path of destruction now doesn't make a difference to him, but it might matter to you.

[list]
[*]You can now toggle between [b]Fullscreen[/b] and [b]Windowed[/b] modes. Press [b]F[/b] for Fullscreen and [b]G[/b] for Windowed. This makes alt-tabbing away from the game possible, because it's 2018.

[*]Music can now be muted properly across the entire game instead of having to toggle it on/off per match. [b]N[/b] = music off, [b]M[/b] = music on. Now you can stream your own obscure EDM music quietly in the background while you're streaming and talking to your millions of fans.
[/list]

Have a great quack up,
-[url=www.attackmountain.com]ATKMTN[/url]

Music can now be muted properly across the entire game instead of having to toggle it on/off per match. [b]N[/b] = music off, [b]M[/b] = music on. Now you can stream your own obscure EDM music quietly in the background while you're streaming and talking to your millions of fans.
